thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-15 extends the negative macro thread with a more severe data point: 'Stocks drop, oil climbs and Treasury yields hit 19-year high.' This is a genuine, broad-market risk-off signal, but for a conservative sleeve it argues for continued caution and patience, not for selling the small diversified VTI holding into weakness or for deploying fresh cash into a falling tape. The rest of the pack is single-name/international commentary (Chinese auto sales, Meta Muse pricing, crypto price calls) and routine politician PTR filings. Existing VTI position (~22.5 of ~107.5 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding through the drawdown rather than reacting to it, consistent with capital preservation.
